title: correspondenceData-prefill
description: Simplified data model for consumers to prefill the Correspondence form via multipart instantiation. The Requestor is filled from the logged-in user via ER/DSF registers. For self-identified (email) users, use the optional submitter object.

inquiryMessage.description: Content of message or inquiry from customer. Free text.

domain.description: Concerned field of expertise. Valid values: trademark, design, patent, other

contactReference.description: Customer's case reference number from NIPO

ipCases.description: List of IP case identifiers (application numbers, IP right numbers, etc.)

submitter.description: Optional submitter (requestor) data for self-identified (email) users, since no national register data is available. Ignored for person/org users, where register data is used.

PrefillSubmitter.description: Submitter identity. Provide either firstName + lastName or companyName, together with streetAddress, postalCode, city, and country.

firstName.description: First name. Used together with lastName for person submitters.

lastName.description: Last name. Used together with firstName for person submitters.

companyName.description: Company name. Alternative to firstName + lastName for organization submitters.

country.description: Country code. Use the returned value from the countries options endpoint; labels are display text only.
